synths.deleteHasPatches: The synth is still used by {count} patch(es). Delete those patches first.
auth.serverError: The server could not process the request right now. Please try again later.
auth.resetRequested: If an account exists for this address, we sent a reset link.
auth.resetTokenMissing: The link is incomplete. Request a new one.
auth.resetTokenInvalid: The link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
revisionLoss.title: Some settings no longer fit
revisionLoss.intro: “{patch}” was saved with revision {from} of {synth}. The panel has since changed to revision {to} and no longer has a control for these settings:
revisionLoss.outro: “Save” updates the patch to revision {to} and removes these settings. “Restore previous version” discards your changes and reloads the last saved version. “Cancel” keeps your changes, and you go on working in revision {from}.
revisionLoss.upgradeIntro: Revision {to} of {synth} no longer has a control for these settings of “{patch}”:
revisionLoss.upgradeOutro: They are lost when you update. Set them again manually afterwards if needed.
revisionLoss.outdated: This patch uses revision {from} of {synth} (outdated, current is revision {to}).
synths.panelQuota: Your panel storage is full (at most 50 panels or 50 MB). Delete synths you no longer need and try again.
synths.categoriesHint: Optional. Categories give knobs and switches their own color and are the layers of a selector switch (e.g. Shift). Without a category the default color applies.
synths.categoryScaleHint: Factor from 0.25 to 4; 1 is the default size. Knobs and LEDs stay round.
synths.categoryRemoveText: “{name}” is used by {count} control(s). These assignments will be removed.
synths.selectorHint: At least two categories. A click moves to the next one.
synths.selectorNeedsCategories: Add at least two categories first.
synths.dependentHint: Keeps its own state for each category of the selector and shows that category's color.
synths.dependentNeedsSelector: Dependent switches need a selector switch first.
synths.issuesTitle: Categories and switches do not fit together
synths.issuesOutro: “Fix and save” removes the faulty assignments and saves. You can set them again afterwards.
synths.issue.unknown-category: “{control}” refers to a category that no longer exists.
synths.issue.selector-too-few: The selector switch “{control}” needs at least two categories.
synths.issue.selector-duplicate: The selector switch “{control}” contains “{category}” more than once.
synths.issue.selector-with-parent: “{control}” is a selector switch and depends on another switch.
synths.issue.selector-with-category: The selector switch “{control}” has a fixed color.
synths.issue.dependent-with-category: The dependent switch “{control}” has a fixed color.
synths.issue.parent-missing: “{control}” depends on a switch that no longer exists.
synths.issue.parent-not-selector: “{control}” depends on “{parent}”, which is not a selector switch.
synths.unsavedText: Your changes to the synth are not saved yet. Closing without saving discards them. Save a new revision now?
synths.unsavedHint: Changes not saved yet – no new revision has been created.
admin.title: Administration
admin.synths.title: Synth management
admin.synths.intro: New synths are visible only to their creator and admins until approved. Deleted synths are hidden everywhere and can be restored or removed for good.
admin.synths.saveFailed: The approval of “{name}” could not be saved. Please try again.
synths.visibilityPendingOwn: Awaiting approval – visible only to you
synths.visibilityPendingOthers: Awaiting approval – visible only to its creator and admins
synths.approvalFailed: The approval could not be saved. Please try again.
admin.synths.actionFailed: The action for “{name}” failed. Please try again.
admin.synths.reduceHint: Reduce revisions: {count} old revision(s) can go. Kept: the newest {keep}, the current one and every revision a patch uses.
admin.synths.reduceText: {count} old revision(s) of “{name}” will be removed, with panel images only they used. Kept: the newest {keep}, the current one and every revision a patch uses.
admin.synths.purgeText: “{name}” will be removed for good: all revisions, {patches} patch(es) of {users} user(s), their samples and the panel images. This cannot be undone.
admin.users.title: Users
admin.users.intro: Deactivated accounts cannot sign in and are signed out at once. Confirm an email address by hand if the confirmation mail did not arrive. Only the owner changes roles. Deactivated accounts can be deleted for good.
admin.users.saveFailed: The change for {name} could not be saved. Please try again.
auth.accountDisabled: This account has been deactivated. Please contact an admin.
auth.disabledText: An admin has deactivated your account, so you cannot save or change anything anymore. If you think this is a mistake, please contact an admin.
admin.samples.title: Samples
admin.samples.intro: Every uploaded sample, by the synth of the patch that uses it. Files no patch uses anymore (e.g. because their patch was deleted) come first and can potentially be removed.
admin.samples.unusedCount: {count} sample file(s) not used by any patch.
admin.samples.noneUnused: Every sample file is used by a patch.
admin.samples.unusedHint: Not used by any patch – can potentially be removed
admin.backup.title: Import/Export
admin.backup.intro: A backup holds everything: accounts, synths with all revisions, patches, tags, samples and every file. It is saved on this computer only. Sign-ins are not part of it.
admin.backup.exportText: Saves a ZIP file with all data and files. Keep it somewhere safe: it contains every account (with password hashes) and email address.
admin.backup.importText: Replaces all data of this instance with a backup, also one from another instance or an older version of the app. A backup of the current state is downloaded first.
admin.backup.notABackup: This file is not a backup of this app.
admin.backup.restoreText: All data of this instance will be replaced by the backup: accounts, synths, patches and samples. A backup of the current state is downloaded first. Afterwards everyone, you included, has to sign in again.
admin.backup.restored: The backup has been restored. Everyone has been signed out; you will be taken to the sign-in.
admin.backup.error.export-failed: The backup could not be created.
admin.backup.error.upload-failed: A file could not be uploaded. Nothing has been replaced.
admin.backup.error.newer-backup: This backup is from a newer version of the app and cannot be restored here. Nothing has been replaced.
admin.backup.error.restore-failed: The backup could not be restored. Nothing has been replaced.
admin.patches.title: Patches
admin.patches.intro: Every patch, private ones included, by synth. For looking only, for now.
admin.patches.outdatedHint: Stored with an older synth revision; the synth is at revision {current}.
admin.backup.exportedMissing: The backup has been downloaded, but {count} file(s) the database refers to were missing in storage and are not in it: {files}
admin.backup.summaryMissing: {count} file(s) were already missing when this backup was made.
admin.backup.error.file-failed: A file could not be loaded: {detail}
mail.verify.subject: Please confirm your email address
mail.verify.heading: Confirm your email address
mail.verify.body: Thanks for signing up. Confirm your email address and you are ready to go.
mail.verify.note: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this mail.
mail.reset.subject: Reset your password
mail.reset.heading: Reset your password
mail.reset.body: Set a new password with this link. It is valid for one hour.
mail.reset.note: If you did not ask for this, your password stays as it is.
mail.synthPending.subject: New synth awaits approval: {synth}
mail.synthPending.heading: New synth to approve
mail.synthPending.body: {creator} ({email}) created the synth “{synth}”. Everyone sees it once an admin approves it.
auth.welcomeText: You have signed up and are signed in. You can get started now: create and save patches, and add your own synths.
auth.verifyFailedText: The confirmation link has expired or is invalid. Sign in with your email address and password, and we will send you a new link.
auth.checkMailTo: We have sent an email to {email}. Click the link in it to confirm your address.
auth.checkMailSpam: The link is valid for one hour. Please check your spam folder too.
auth.resendDone: We have sent you a new email.
auth.resendFailed: The email could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
mail.accountDeleted.subject: Your account is being deleted
mail.accountDeleted.heading: Your account is being deleted
mail.accountDeleted.body: An admin is deleting your account at the CV Patch Registry. Your private patches and your sign-in data are removed. Public patches and synths you created stay for others, but without your name and email address.
mail.accountDeleted.attachment: Attached is everything we had stored about you: your account, your patches and your synths as a JSON file in a ZIP archive.
mail.accountDeleted.note: If you think this is a mistake, please contact an admin. A deleted account cannot be restored, but you can sign up again at any time.
admin.users.deleteAria: Delete the account of {name} for good
admin.users.deleteHint: Deactivate the account first, then it can be deleted for good.
admin.users.deleteText: {name} ({email}) first gets an email with all stored data. Then the account, its sign-in data and all private patches with their samples are deleted. Public patches and created synths stay and are shown as “Deleted user”. This cannot be undone.
admin.users.deleted: The account of {name} has been deleted. Its data was emailed to {email}.
admin.users.deleteFailed: The account of {name} could not be deleted.
admin.users.deleteMailFailed: The email with the data could not be sent to {name}, so nothing has been deleted.
mail.deletionRequested.subject: Account deletion requested: {name}
mail.deletionRequested.heading: An account is to be deleted
mail.deletionRequested.body: {name} ({email}) asked for their account to be deleted. The account is already deactivated. Delete it for good in user management; the person then gets a copy of their data by email.
account.requestDeletionText: The admins are notified and your account is deactivated right away: you are signed out and cannot sign in again. Once an admin deletes the account, you get an email with all stored data. Public patches and your synths stay, without your name.
account.requestDeletionDone: Your account is deactivated and you have been signed out. Once an admin deletes it, you get an email with your data.
account.requestDeletionFailed: Your request could not be sent. Your account stays as it is; please try again later.
